slices.notes: Canary slice. South->F9. 3 presses -> 3 exact F9 pairs at XI2. Run before each batch sub-session. All canary passes confirmed (3/3).

East: F10 full-press / F11 long-press @450ms default. Presses at 430/450/470ms. Steam hold fires INCLUSIVE at 450ms (>= threshold). Cross-runtime delta: JSM hold boundary is exclusive + poll-interval offset (~1 poll above HOLD_PRESS_TIME). Converter must account for inclusive vs exclusive boundary semantics.

North: F12 single / F7 double @190ms default. Gaps 170/190/210ms (down-to-down). Steam window EXCLUSIVE at 190ms measured down-to-down: 170ms fires double, 190ms fires two singles. Contradicts C1 JSM anomaly (JSM fired double at 160ms gap; reference is probably not down-to-down). Both timing models need wider probe to nail JSM boundary.

ANOMALY — DO NOT PROMOTE. Staged 0->100->255 and instant 0->255 both emit F4 only; F3 (soft/edge) never fires. Contradicts Phase-2 steam result which showed F3+F4 for staged pull. Hypothesis: adaptive_threshold=3 requires RZ>100 to cross edge activator. Follow-up slice trigramp_highsoft (RZ=200) needed. Do not update findings/steam_lane_behavior.md until resolved.

interruptable=0 on Full_Press activator. Short press (120ms): F10 only. Long press (600ms): F10 fires on press-down AND F11 fires at 450ms threshold — both active simultaneously. Confirms Steamworks doc: interruptable=0 allows Regular to fire alongside Long. Schema implication: taphold normalized-stream and delta schemas must carry interruptable state. Converter cannot assume exclusive tap/hold without reading this per-activator VDF parameter.
